verdict.rationale: Pylon supports natural-language operation via Assist Agent chat, Ask AI, Slack Agent, and natural-language runbooks that configure agent behavior, plus MCP integration letting AI tools like Claude/ChatGPT issue natural-language commands against Pylon data. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of natural-language command accuracy and no evidence of a general-purpose NL command palette across the entire product surface (e.g., admin/config actions via NL).
